pois.name: Farul Genovez
pois.intro: The Genoese Lighthouse is a lighthouse and historic monument situated on the waterfront of the city of Constanța, Romania, behind a group of statues which has in its center the bust of Mihai Eminescu, sculpted by Oscar Han. It is located near Constanța Casino.

pois.name: Geamia Hunchiar
pois.intro: The Hünkar Mosque is a mosque located at 41 Tomis Boulevard, Constanța, Romania.

pois.name: German coastal battery Tirpitz
pois.intro: The German coastal battery Tirpitz, consisting mainly of three large 280 mm guns, was the most powerful coastal battery on the Romanian shore during World War II. The three guns, model 28 cm SK L/45, came from spares for the World War I-era Nassau-class battleships. The name of the battery was given after German Grand Admiral Alfred von Tirpitz.

pois.name: Cazinoul Constanța
pois.intro: The Constanța Casino is a casino located in Constanța, Romania. Designated by the Romanian Ministry of Culture and National Patrimony as a historic monument, the casino is situated on the Constanța seafront along the Black Sea in the historic Peninsulă District of the city.

pois.name: Moscheea Carol I
pois.intro: The Grand Mosque of Constanța, originally known as the Carol I Mosque, is a mosque in Constanța, Romania. It is listed as an historic monument by the Romanian National Institute of Historical Monuments.

pois.name: Trajan's Wall
pois.intro: Trajan's Wall is the name used for several linear earthen fortifications found across Eastern Europe, Moldova, Romania, and Ukraine. Contrary to the name and popular belief, evidence shows the ramparts were likely not built under the reign of Trajan, but later, in the period of Late Antiquity and Early Middle Ages.

pois.name: Muzeul de Istorie Națională și Arheologie
pois.wikipedia: ro:Muzeul de Istorie și Arheologie din Constanța
pois.intro: The Constanța History and Archaeology Museum is a museum located at 12 Piața Ovidiu, Constanța, Romania.

pois.name: Catedrala Ortodoxă „Sfinții Apostoli Petru și Pavel”
pois.nameEnglish: Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul
pois.wikipedia: ro:Catedrala Sfinții Petru și Pavel din Constanța
pois.intro: The Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul, Constanța, located at 25 Arhiepiscopiei Street, Constanța, Romania, is the seat of the Romanian Orthodox Archbishop of Tomis, as well as a monastery.

pois.name: Edificiul Roman cu Mozaic
pois.wikipedia: ro:Edificiul roman cu mozaic din Constanța

pois.name: Statuia lui Ovidiu
pois.description: It was executed by the Italian sculptor Ettore Ferrie in 1887 as a tribute to the writer who has lived the last years of his life in exile in Tomis. The bronze statue depicts a writer Ovid meditative stance.
pois.intro: Das Ovid-Denkmal im historischen Zentrum von Constanța, Rumänien, wurde 1887 von dem italienischen Bildhauer Ettore Ferrari geschaffen. Die Statue steht auf der Piața Ovidiu, dem Ovidplatz, vor dem ehemaligen Rathaus von Constanța, dem heutigen Nationalmuseum für Geschichte und Archäologie, in der Nähe des Hafens.

pois.description: Descoperă preparatele noastre vegane din ingrediente integrale și naturale. Avem un meniu variat pentru toate gusturile, supe, ciorbe, feluri principale și deserturi gătite cu pricepere. Mâncarea sănătoasă este și gustoasă!
